drafts.text:
Same lesson. Different account.
September it cost me the $6K Challenge, -$3,148 in one session.
Monday it was almost $1k of a Vest account I'd run up from $10.
Different size. Same move. I stayed in because leaving meant admitting I was wrong.
Stop fighting the tape. That's the whole lesson. I just keep paying to relearn it.
drafts.source: Sep 21 failure thread (-$3,148, real) + Oct 13 Vest post (almost $1k, real) + Jesus's own held line 'Stop fighting the tape. That's the whole lesson.'
drafts.why: The same mistake at two very different sizes proves size was never the variable, an insight he hasn't posted yet. Real numbers on both sides, keeps the $6K arc alive.
drafts.why_es: El mismo error en dos tamaños muy distintos prueba que el tamaño nunca fue la variable, un insight que aún no ha publicado. Números reales de ambos lados y mantiene vivo el arco del $6K.

drafts.text:
The setup was never the hard part.
The hard part is admitting the trade is dead while you're still in it.
You don't hold a loser because you think it'll come back. You hold it because leaving makes it official.
drafts.source: Jesus's own reply to @dctrades22 on the Oct 13 Vest post.
drafts.why: Distilled version of his best real line of the window, no question, post 2+ days after the Vest post so it isn't a duplicate.
drafts.why_es: Versión destilada de su mejor línea real de la ventana, sin pregunta, publicar 2+ días después del post del Vest para que no sea duplicado.

drafts.text:
Most people asked how I made it. Fewer asked about the part where I almost gave it back.
The honest answer on making it: luck, and a few clean days in a row.
The honest answer on giving it back: me, at my desk, refusing to say I was wrong.
Only one of those two is something I can actually work on.
drafts.source: Jesus's own 'was luck' reply to @mannyjplays + the proof post's 'I'm not going to pretend this was pure skill'.
drafts.why: Turns the 4x framing gap (3,049 vs 722) into a post. Confirm 'fewer asked' feels true before posting.
drafts.why_es: Convierte la brecha de 4x entre enmarques (3,049 vs 722) en un post. Confirma que 'fewer asked' se siente cierto antes de publicar.
